name: Local Images
description: Image generation through a local image server on loopback, with several models the agent picks per call.

baseUrl.description: The image server's base URL. Loopback only (127.0.0.1, [::1] or localhost); any other host leaves the provider unconfigured.

models.description: Model ids the image server serves. The first is the default; the agent picks another per call with model=local-images/<id>.
